description: Verify that a vacation-rental host domain is a valid Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) node before trusting it. Reads the domain's .well-known/vacation-rental.json and JWKS. Read-only trust check: no availability, pricing, booking, or payment — do NOT use it to answer those questions. Use when a host domain arrives from outside search (user-typed or third-party); domains returned by hemmabo_search_properties can go straight to get_verified_stay_offer. On success, call get_verified_stay_offer with the same domain and stay dates. The single input is the host domain as a bare hostname (no scheme or path); public domains only — IPs, ports, and local/private hostnames are refused. Pass the node's canonical domain exactly — www and apex are distinct identities, and verification fails when the domain's declared canonical_domain differs from the one you passed. Verification reads that domain's own .well-known and JWKS, so the result is only as trustworthy as the exact domain you pass. Booking and payment happen only on the host's own domain, at the signed direct_booking_url; this server has no booking, checkout, or payment step.

domain.description: Host-owned domain without protocol or path (e.g. 'villaakerlyckan.se', 'myvilla.it'). Invalid: 'https://...', paths, ports, or booking URLs.

name: verify_vacation_rental_node

discovery_url.description: The .well-known vacation-rental discovery URL read from the host domain.

domain.description: Echoed canonical host domain that was checked.

error.description: Present when verified=false or the node cannot be checked.

jwks_url.description: Host-domain JWKS URL containing the Ed25519 public keys used to verify signed offers.

protocol.description: Protocol identifier discovered on the host domain. A valid node declares exactly 'vacation-rental-protocol' in its .well-known/vacation-rental.json protocol field, and that is the value returned here.

protocol_version.description: VRP version declared by the host discovery document.

signing.description: Summary of accepted signing algorithms, key ids, and signing-key checks.

verified.description: True only when discovery, JWKS, signing metadata, and verified-offer endpoint checks pass.

verified_stay_offer_url.description: Host-domain endpoint template or URL used to request signed verified stay offers.

title: Verify Vacation Rental Node
